dialogue.content: こんばんは相談員です。本日はどういったご相談でしょうか。
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm a counselor. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: はい、私は中学1年女子です
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm a first-year junior high school girl.

dialogue.content: 教えていただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: 学校で陸上部に所属していますが
dialogue.English: I'm in the track and field club at school, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 部活で、10月中旬ぐらいから孤立しています
dialogue.English: In my club, I've been isolated since around mid-October.

dialogue.content: それで、部活に行くのが辛いです
dialogue.English: Because of that, it's hard for me to go to my club activities.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what has been happening.

dialogue.content: それはさみしいしつらいですね。
dialogue.English: That must be very lonely and difficult for you.

dialogue.content: 孤立したきっかけなどはあるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do you have any sense of what might have triggered the isolation?

dialogue.content: いや、特に思い当たることないです
dialogue.English: No, I can't think of anything in particular.

dialogue.content: 誰に話しかけても、無視です
dialogue.English: No matter who I talk to, they ignore me.

dialogue.content: それは寂しいですね・・・
dialogue.English: That must feel very lonely...

dialogue.content: だから、いつも行きたくないし、いつも一人で部活をしています
dialogue.English: So I never want to go, and I always do my club activities alone.

dialogue.content: 急に皆さんの態度が変わったのですか？
dialogue.English: Did everyone's attitude change suddenly?

dialogue.content: はい、徐々にという感じですかね
dialogue.English: Yes—well, it felt more gradual.

dialogue.content: 私は、塾に行っているのですが
dialogue.English: I go to a cram school, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そのことで、部活を途中でやめて塾に行かなくちゃならなくて
dialogue.English: Because of that, I have to leave club practice early to go to cram school.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 一人の人が、そのことを気に入らないらしいです
dialogue.English: It seems one person doesn't like that.

dialogue.content: ではそれがきっかけの可能性がありそうですね。。。
dialogue.English: So it seems possible that could be the trigger...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その人が気に入らないらしいということは、どこで知ったのですか？
dialogue.English: How did you find out that this person doesn't seem to like it?

dialogue.content: こそこそといっていることが耳に入ってきました
dialogue.English: I overheard them whispering about it.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。。。それを聞いてどう感じましたか？
dialogue.English: I see... How did you feel when you heard that?

dialogue.content: 困りましたし、悲しく、寂しくなりました
dialogue.English: I felt troubled, sad, and lonely.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。。。悲しいですよね。。。
dialogue.English: I can understand that... That must be very sad...

dialogue.content: 誰にも相談できなくて、今日ここに相談にきました
dialogue.English: I couldn't talk to anyone about it, so I came here today.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。来てくれてありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for coming.

dialogue.content: はい、よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you for your help.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします＾＾塾というのは勉強の塾ですか？
dialogue.English: Likewise. Is the cram school for academic studies?

dialogue.content: はい、そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 週2回あります
dialogue.English: I go twice a week.

dialogue.content: 週２で通っているのですね。
dialogue.English: So you go twice a week.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 部活に勉強に大忙しですね。
dialogue.English: You must be very busy with both club activities and your studies.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 誰にも言えなくて、辛かったです
dialogue.English: Not being able to tell anyone has been hard.

dialogue.content: つらかったのによく我慢して耐えてきましたね。。。
dialogue.English: You've done so well to endure it, even though it's been so hard...

dialogue.content: いつも、部活に行く時間になるとドキドキします
dialogue.English: Whenever it's time to go to club activities, my heart starts pounding.

dialogue.content: 部活に行くのが怖いのですね。
dialogue.English: So going to your club activities feels scary.

dialogue.content: はい、怖いです
dialogue.English: Yes, it does.

dialogue.content: 本当は行きたくありません
dialogue.English: I really don't want to go.

dialogue.content: 「本当は」というと？
dialogue.English: What do you mean by 'really'?

dialogue.content: でも、行かないようにすることもできなくて
dialogue.English: But I can't just not go.

dialogue.content: 行かなくてはならない理由があるのですか？
dialogue.English: Is there a reason you feel you have to go?

dialogue.content: 親も知らないし
dialogue.English: My parents don't know,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: うちの親に行っても、それでも行きなさいというだけなので
dialogue.English: Even if I told my parents, they'd just tell me to go anyway.

dialogue.content: なぜそういわれると思うのですか？
dialogue.English: Why do you think they would say that?

dialogue.content: いつもそうだからです
dialogue.English: Because that's what they always do.

dialogue.content: 親身になって聞いてもらったことないです
dialogue.English: They've never really listened to me with empathy.

dialogue.content: 母親は、小さな弟の面倒で毎日忙しそうだし
dialogue.English: My mother seems busy every day taking care of my little brother,

dialogue.content: それは寂しいですね。。。私の親もそうだったので気持ちわかります。
dialogue.English: That must be lonely... My parents were like that too, so I understand how you feel.

dialogue.content: 私は、兄弟が5人と多くて
dialogue.English: I have five siblings, so there are a lot of us.

dialogue.content: 甘えてられないんです
dialogue.English: I can't afford to lean on anyone.

dialogue.content: 多いですね！？
dialogue.English: That's a lot!

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ご相談者様は兄弟の何番目なのですか？
dialogue.English: Where are you in the birth order?

dialogue.content: 一番下は、まだ2歳です
dialogue.English: The youngest is still two years old.

dialogue.content: 一番上です
dialogue.English: I'm the oldest.

dialogue.content: 一番上だからしっかりしないとと思うのですね。えらいですね＾＾
dialogue.English: Because you're the oldest, you feel you have to be responsible. That's very admirable.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: I guess so.

dialogue.content: 迷惑をかけてはいけないとも思います
dialogue.English: I also feel that I shouldn't be a burden.

dialogue.content: でも時には甘えたいですよね。。。
dialogue.English: But sometimes you want to be able to lean on someone, don't you...

dialogue.content: 面倒をかけたくないというか
dialogue.English: It's more that I don't want to be a burden.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私の親もそうでした。
dialogue.English: My parents were like that too.

dialogue.content: 甘えるということがどういうことなのかもわかりません
dialogue.English: I don't even really know what it means to lean on someone.

dialogue.content: 甘えること苦手です
dialogue.English: I'm not good at relying on others.

dialogue.content: なんでも自分でしないととおもってしまいます
dialogue.English: I feel like I have to do everything myself.

dialogue.content: 今までよく耐えてきましたね。
dialogue.English: You've endured so much up to now.

dialogue.content: でも、
dialogue.English: But—

dialogue.content: そうするしかなかったんです
dialogue.English: I had no other choice.

dialogue.content: 誰かを頼ってはいけないという人間なんていません。
dialogue.English: Everyone is allowed to rely on others.

dialogue.content: 部活以外でお友達はいますか？
dialogue.English: Do you have friends outside of your club?

dialogue.content: ただ救いは、クラスが楽しいことです
dialogue.English: The one saving grace is that my class is fun.

dialogue.content: お
dialogue.English: Oh.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: クラスに友達がいます
dialogue.English: I have friends in my class.

dialogue.content: クラスにはお友達がいるのですね＾＾
dialogue.English: So you do have friends in your class.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: だから、まだ救われます
dialogue.English: So that's a relief.

dialogue.content: そのお友達はこの部活の件は知っているのですか？
dialogue.English: Do those friends know about the situation with your club?

dialogue.content: それがなかったら、学校に行けなくなっていたかもしれません
dialogue.English: If I didn't have that, I might not have been able to go to school.

dialogue.content: そのお友達はとても素敵な存在ですね。
dialogue.English: It sounds like those friends are a wonderful presence in your life.

dialogue.content: はい、なんとなく
dialogue.English: Yes, they have a vague idea.

dialogue.content: 何人かいます
dialogue.English: There are a few of them.

dialogue.content: 仲のいい友達
dialogue.English: Close friends.

dialogue.content: では学校で独りではないのですね？
dialogue.English: So you're not alone at school, then?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: それを聞けて安心しました＾＾
dialogue.English: I'm relieved to hear that.

dialogue.content: 部活で、この状態がいつまで続くのかと思うと気が重くなります
dialogue.English: When I think about how long this situation in my club will continue, I feel disheartened.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。。。少しお話をまとめさせていただいてもよろしいでしょうか。
dialogue.English: I understand... Would it be all right if I took a moment to summarize what we've talked about?

dialogue.content: この間、あまりにも辛いので、どこか遠くに行ってしまいたい、この場からいなくなってしまいたいと思いました
dialogue.English: The other day, it was so hard that I felt like I wanted to go somewhere far away—to just disappear from this place.

dialogue.content: それほどつらかったのですね。。。
dialogue.English: It was that painful for you...

dialogue.content: お風呂にホースがあったので、首に巻き付けてどんなふうになるか試してみました
dialogue.English: There was a hose in the bathroom, so I tried wrapping it around my neck to see what would happen.

dialogue.content: そうしたらどうなりました？
dialogue.English: What happened when you did that?

dialogue.content: 気が遠くなる感じで、このままにしたら、本当遠いところにいってしまうのかもしれないと思いました
dialogue.English: I started to feel faint, and I thought that if I kept it like that, I might really go to a faraway place.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そのまま遠いところに行こうとしなかったのですか？
dialogue.English: Did you consider continuing on to that faraway place?

dialogue.content: 部活でしゃべれる人がいないので、こそこそ話されていると自分のことをはなしているんじゃないかと辛くなります
dialogue.English: Since there's no one I can talk to in the club, when people whisper, I feel like they must be talking about me, and it's painful.

dialogue.content: なんででしょうかね
dialogue.English: I wonder why.

dialogue.content: 少しこわくなったのもあります
dialogue.English: I also got a little scared.

dialogue.content: 怖く感じたのですね。
dialogue.English: You felt scared.

dialogue.content: 何が怖かったのでしょう？
dialogue.English: What was it that you were scared of?

dialogue.content: 今いるところ、自分の存在がなくなるということですかね
dialogue.English: I guess the idea of my existence, here and now, disappearing.

dialogue.content: 弟や妹にも両親にもじいちゃん、ばあちゃんにも、友達にも会えなくなるとか
dialogue.English: Like not being able to see my younger sister and brothers, my parents, my grandpa and grandma, or my friends anymore.

dialogue.content: うんうん。ではまだ「生きたい」と思ったのかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. Then perhaps a part of you still wanted to live.

dialogue.content: 家族のことは好きですか？
dialogue.English: Do you love your family?

dialogue.content: 家族そうですね～
dialogue.English: My family... well...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 好きなのかな？
dialogue.English: I wonder if I love them.

dialogue.content: かな？って感じなのね。
dialogue.English: So it's an "I wonder" kind of feeling for you.

dialogue.content: 父親は、厳しすぎるし、
dialogue.English: My father is too strict,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 母親は、話をきいてくれるかんじではないし
dialogue.English: and my mother isn't the type to really listen.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: もっと話をきいてほしいし、気に留めてほしいですよねｎ
dialogue.English: I want them to listen to me more and pay more attention to me.

dialogue.content: そう感じるのですね。
dialogue.English: That's how you feel.

dialogue.content: もっとかまってほしいのですね。
dialogue.English: You'd like more attention.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 兄弟のことは好きですか？
dialogue.English: Do you like your siblings?

dialogue.content: はい、すぐ下の妹とは気が合いませんが
dialogue.English: Yes, though I don't get along with my immediate younger sister.

dialogue.content: 弟たちとは、気が合います。
dialogue.English: But I do get along with my younger brothers.

dialogue.content: なら弟たちはかわいいでしょう＾＾
dialogue.English: Then your brothers must be precious to you.

dialogue.content: はい、とても
dialogue.English: Yes, very much so.

dialogue.content: それはよかった。
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear that.

dialogue.content: 一番下は、2歳なので存在が癒されます
dialogue.English: The youngest is two, so just having him around is comforting.

dialogue.content: その年だときっとかわいいし、天使のようですよね＾＾
dialogue.English: At that age, they're surely adorable, like a little angel.

dialogue.content: はい、そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 今日はご相談者様にたくさん大切な話をしていただきましたが、
dialogue.English: You've shared many important things with me today,

dialogue.content: 天使そのとおりですね
dialogue.English: An angel, that's exactly right.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 部活のことや両親のこと、
dialogue.English: About your club, your parents,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今のご相談者様が「つらい」という気持ちは何が変わればなくなるでしょうか。
dialogue.English: What do you think would need to change for your current feeling of 'pain' to go away?

dialogue.content: もちろん、無視されることがなくなることですかね
dialogue.English: Well, of course, if I stopped being ignored.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。それは部活を続けたいということでしょうか。それとも部活を辞めるのでもいいのでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Right. Does that mean you want to continue with the club? Or would you be okay with quitting?

dialogue.content: 部活は、目標があるので、達成させたいので続けたいです
dialogue.English: I want to continue with my club because I have a goal I want to achieve.

dialogue.content: 目標があることはいいことですね＾＾
dialogue.English: It's a wonderful thing to have a goal.

dialogue.content: どうやったら無視はされなくなると思いますか？
dialogue.English: What do you think would make the ignoring stop?

dialogue.content: 2年生になったら、県大会で入賞したいです
dialogue.English: When I'm a second-year, I want to place at the prefectural meet.

dialogue.content: わかりません
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: いい目標ですね。無視の原因ですが、、、
dialogue.English: That's a great goal. Regarding the cause of the ignoring...

dialogue.content: 塾で途中抜けすることが気に入らないと思われているのですよね？
dialogue.English: You think it's because they don't like that you leave early for cram school, right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 塾を辞めたら無視されなくなりそうですか？
dialogue.English: If you quit cram school, do you think they would stop ignoring you?

dialogue.content: わかりません
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: 難しい問題ですものね。。。
dialogue.English: It's a difficult problem, isn't it...

dialogue.content: 中心になっている子は、次から次にターゲットを変えているように感じます
dialogue.English: The person at the center of it seems to change targets, one after another.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。では被害者はほかにもいるのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. So are there others who have been targeted?

dialogue.content: はい、私の前にもいました
dialogue.English: Yes, there was someone before me.

dialogue.content: その時あなたはそのターゲットの子にどう接していましたか？
dialogue.English: At that time, how did you interact with the student who was being targeted?

dialogue.content: だから、他の部員はいつ自分がされるかと思っているのかなと
dialogue.English: So, I wonder if the other club members are thinking about when it will be their turn.

dialogue.content: 普通にしていました
dialogue.English: I treated them normally.

dialogue.content: いつもと同じように
dialogue.English: Just like always.

dialogue.content: 優しいですね＾＾
dialogue.English: That's kind of you.

dialogue.content: あなたは部活で今、全員に無視されているのですか？
dialogue.English: Is everyone in the club ignoring you now?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 以前ターゲットだった子も？
dialogue.English: Even the person who was targeted before?

dialogue.content: やめました
dialogue.English: She quit.

dialogue.content: なるほど。。。
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: その子が辞めたからあなたにターゲットが移ったのかもしれませんね。。。
dialogue.English: It's possible the target shifted to you after that person quit...

dialogue.content: 解決の糸口がみえなくて、つらいです
dialogue.English: I can't see any way to resolve this, and it's painful.

dialogue.content: そうなのかもしれません
dialogue.English: That might be the case.

dialogue.content: そうですね。。。非常に難しい問題ですね。。。
dialogue.English: Yes... It's a very difficult situation...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そろそろお時間になってしまうので、今回の相談で完璧な解決策は出せないかもしれませんが、
dialogue.English: We're about out of time for today, so we may not be able to find a perfect solution in this session, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 部活で独りで練習することは頑張れますか？
dialogue.English: Can you manage to keep practicing by yourself at the club?

dialogue.content: つらいけど
dialogue.English: It's hard, but...

dialogue.content: できるかぎりがんばるつもりです
dialogue.English: I intend to do the best I can.

dialogue.content: 目標のためには練習できそうですか？
dialogue.English: Do you feel you can keep practicing for the sake of your goal?

dialogue.content: あと、遠くだけど今日話を聞いてもらったので
dialogue.English: Also, even though you're far away, because you listened to me today,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 遠くで、自分を応援してくれている人がいると思うと、
dialogue.English: knowing that there's someone far away cheering for me,

dialogue.content: 少し心強く感じます
dialogue.English: makes me feel a little stronger.

dialogue.content: また、辛くなったら相談に来てもいいですか
dialogue.English: If things get tough again, is it okay if I come back to talk?

dialogue.content: 私はご相談者様の味方になりますし、応援もします！
dialogue.English: I am on your side, and I will be cheering for you!

dialogue.content: もちろんです！
dialogue.English: Of course!

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes,

dialogue.content: 今日は、ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for today.

dialogue.content: それにこの場所だけでなく、クラスのお友達もあなたの味方です＾＾
dialogue.English: And it's not just this place; your friends in class are on your side too.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたは独りじゃないですよ。
dialogue.English: You're not alone.

dialogue.content: そうでした
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 今日相談にきて、自分は一人ではないことに気づきました
dialogue.English: Coming here to talk today made me realize that I'm not alone.

dialogue.content: それが大きな収穫になりました
dialogue.English: That was a big takeaway for me.

dialogue.content: 解決策をビシッと出せませんでしたが、今日は相談してどうでしたか？
dialogue.English: I wasn't able to give you a clear-cut solution, but how do you feel after talking with me today?

dialogue.content: 気持ちが少しは楽にはなりましたか？
dialogue.English: Do you feel a little better?

dialogue.content: はい、明日も部活ですが少し頑張れそうです
dialogue.English: Yes, I have club practice tomorrow, and I feel like I can try a little harder.

dialogue.content: 少し楽になりました
dialogue.English: I feel a little better.

dialogue.content: それはよかった＾＾
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear that.

dialogue.content: またつらくなったら来てください。
dialogue.English: Please come back anytime it gets tough again.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I will.

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for today.

dialogue.content: 次来た時もしかしたら相談員が別のものになるかもしれませんが、
dialogue.English: The next time you come, you might have a different counselor,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: このやり取りは残るので、他の者もあなたの味方になってくれますので
dialogue.English: but the record of this conversation will remain, so the other counselors will be on your side as well.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 安心してきてください。
dialogue.English: So please don't hesitate to come back.

dialogue.content: 心強いです
dialogue.English: That's very reassuring.

dialogue.content: まかせてください！
dialogue.English: You can count on us!

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: それでは本日はこれで失礼します。
dialogue.English: Well then, that will be all for today.

dialogue.content: (ロールプレイありがとうございました。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for the role-play.)

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: お疲れさまでした
dialogue.English: Thank you for your hard work.
